༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud 'debs dang bkra shis zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: / /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud 'debs dang bkra shis zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ rang bzhin 'od gsal chos dbyings spros bral las/ /dkyil 'khor lhan cig skyes pa bde chen sku/ / ga nga la gang 'dul thabs kyi 'phrin la can / / bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas kun la 'dud / / lag bdun ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'a chang*//bdud bzhi'i stobs 'phrog khro rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /shes rab rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar/ / phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan la li ta/ / 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gshegs a mo gha/ / dngos grub brgyud brnyes ye shes 'byung gnas zhabs/ / phyag 'tshal sogs gong bzhin/ 'jigs mdzad zhal gzigs padma badzra dang*/ / mthu stobs thogs med me tsa ling ba'i zhabs/ / 'jam dpal khro bo dngos byon rdo rje grags/ / phyag 'tshal= / sgra bsgyur mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chos rab dang*/ / gsang sngags rgyud sde'i bdag po ye shes seng*/ / 'phrin las gzi 'od rgyas pa'i 'bum seng la/ /phyag 'tshal= /rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje grub pa'i phul/ /sngags rig rin chen rgyal mtshan mkhar sngon pa/ / spros bral don gzigs rwa ban chos dbyings zhabs/ / phyag 'tshal= / zab don rgyud 'dzin brtson 'grus seng ge'i mtshan/ / chos kyi bkra shis nus mthu mngon gyur can/ / snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag sher seng ba/ / phyag 'tshal= / kun dga' seng ge mkhyen rtogs byin rlabs gter/ / chos kyi seng ge mngon spyod nus mthu'i bdag/ dam pa'i rjes bzung 'jam dbyangs blo gros zhabs/ / phyag 'tshal= / byin rlabs brgyud ldan blo gros rgya mtsho dang*/ / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul khrims rnam rgyal zhabs/ / gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba las grol don grub legs/ / phyag 'tshal= / dus gsum sangs rgyas slob dpon tshul ston pa/ / skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang*/

/ 'gro kun smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi/ / gshin rje gshed dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang man ngag gi brgyud pa'o//yang 'bum seng gi rjes la/ klog skya'i rigs 'khrungs mkhas pa dbang phyug grags/ / rdo rje 'dzin dbang ldongs ston shes rab dpal/ / 'phags pa'i mtshan 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la/ / phyag 'tshal= / mkhas btsun dam par grags pa'i rin rgyal ba/ / lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung dkon rgyal ba/ / mang thos mthar gson bag ston gzhon nu ba/ / phyag 'tshal= / sdom brtson sngags rig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*/ / blo gros mchog gyur 'jam dbyangs ral gri'i mtshan/ / 'dzam gling nyi ma ma gshin las la 'khol/ / phyag 'tshal=/ rig gnas kun byang blo brtan bzhi pa dang*/ / mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug shākya mchog ldan zhabs/ / byams gling mkhas pa dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ / phyag 'tshal= / blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan grol mchog rje/ / rnam dag ye shes thugs mnga' rdo ring dbon/ / gdams pas rgyud grol lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ / phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs gong bzhin bya/ kun rtog gzung 'dzin bdud dpung gshin rje'i tshogs/ / don dam dbyings su gdod nas rtag bcom pa/ / chos kun rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes mchog/ rgyu rgyud gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / dkyil 'khor mchog tu zab mo'i dbang bzhi bskur/ / rdo rje bzhi bdag sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs/ / dri ma rnam bzhi sbyong ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ / dbang don rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / rnam dag ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / rnam pa lam byed zhi khro sbags sgrub tshul/ / rnam gsum zhing sbyong bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi dang*/ / rnal 'byor bzhi ldan bskyed rim mthar phyin shog / nang gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i rim pa las/

/ rlung sems dhū tīr bcings pa'i mi 'gyur bde/ / spros bral rnal 'byor gsum gyi rim pa las/ / zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku mchog thob par shog/ de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ / bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams kun zhi zhing*/ / mthun rkyen dam chos bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ / tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog/ ces gsol ba 'debs shing*/nang mchod 'bul ba sogs la/ kun la 'dud ces pa kun la mchod ces dang*/ gzha na rnams la/ phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas/ kun rtog bzung 'dzin ces pa man chad mi dgos so//brgyud pa'i gtso bo gong du smos pa gnyis po yin la/dbang bka' tsam gyi brgyud pa la/ 'jam ral £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+gyi rjes £©la/ blo brtan gyis thug par byas kyang chog zer/rong pa rga lo/ rong ba sher seng*/ 'jam dbyangs nyag gcig slob dpon dkon bzang*/'jam ral bar zhes ded kyang chog la/rga lo lo mchog pa/ dpal ldan seng ge seng ge rgyal mtshan pa/zhang ston bsod nams grags/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin/gnya' ston rdor grags/bla ma kun dga' seng ge man chad gong bzhin ded kyang chog yang khrom yon pa nas brgyud pa'ang yod/yang rwa lo yab sras kyi rjes su/rdo rje skyabs/rdo rje sra brtan/mkhan po sher gzhon/dkon mkhar ba/chos mgon pa ste rong ri lung phug pa'i bla ma lnga/g.yag sde ze dmar sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ye shes rin chen gnyis/ jo gdan mkhan chen grags tshul ba dang*/rgyal bzang ba gnyis/bla ma rgyal ba thugs rje/kun dga' seng ge ba man chad sngar bzhin ded kyang chogagazhan yang sngags 'chang gzungs pa nas brgyud pa dang*/zhang pa/ brag phug pa/chos rje bla ma/byang seng ba/shar chen/ngor chen/kha char ba/ paṇa chen chos rje man chad sngar bzhin byas kyang chog pa yod/gzhan yang brgyud pa mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod de/gong dkyus su bsgrigs pa gnyis po dam sel sogs skyon dang bral zhing*/dbang rgyud bshad man ngag gsum ka 'joms pa/

byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang bcas pa yin pa las/snga ma ni thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa yin no//'di'i a mo gha ni/a mo gha badzra che ba yin la/me tsa ling pa ni bal bo thugs rje chen po ste/mtshan dngos dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta'o//rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje ni/ rong pa rga lo yin la/ rin chen rgyal mtshan snga ma de ni/gru gu mkhar sngon pa zer ro//£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+phyi ma bzhi thog pa yin/dkon rgyal ba rgu rum pa dang*/bag ston gzhon tshul dang*/tshul rgyal ba gnyis snang thar pa yin/ chos dbyings pa chos bkra shis kun dga' seng ge chos kyi seng ge 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ blo rgyal ba/ tshul khrims rnam rgyal/ don grub pa rnams kyang rwa ban kho na'o//£©de ltar na 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud yig 'di yang 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ maṅga laṃ/ oṃ swā sti/ gang 'dul lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ / mtha' yas 'gro kun thar pa'i lam du 'dren/ / 'jam pa'i rdo rje gshin rje tshul 'dzin pa/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog/ rtsom chen dbus su sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng*/ khro brjid dpa' bo'i gar gyis dge gur rol/ / sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ / rtsol mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon po'i= / 'bar ba'i sku la gzi brjid mtha' yas 'chang*/ / sna tshogs mtshon cha'i rlabs 'phreng 'khrigs pa'i phyag/ nad gdon bgegs rnams zhabs kyis 'og tu gnod/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po'i= / lha dgu'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ / 'pho med lhan skyes bde chen rtags kyis mtshan/ / 'od gsal rnam pa kun ldan dkyil 'khor gtso/ / bcom ldan 'jigs mdzad chen po'i= / dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nang phyogs mtshams su/ / srid gsum dregs pa ma lus 'dul byed sku/ / sna tshogs dbyings dang mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor pa/

/ las kun thogs med 'grub pa'i= / ma mo gshin rje srin po 'dul ba'i sku/ / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms mdzad ro langs brgyad/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing du thogs med rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ / 'jigs byed chen po rnams kyi= / rin chen las grub ye shes lnga yi dngos/ / gzhal med khang bzang sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ / rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' dag rgyas pa'i zhing*/ / ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po'i= / sdang dang gdug can ma lus 'dul ba'i zhing*/ / bran dang pho nya mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi bsten/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas spangs pa'i dngos/ / 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad kyi= / lta ngan 'jom byed sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ / don dam mkhyen pa'i nyin phyed 'od brgya 'bar/ / skyon bral 'dab ma 'bum ldan pad ma'i gdan/ / dkyil 'khor bzhi yi dge legs=/ mi phyed rdo rje sa gzhi rwa ba gur/ / bar chad bdud sde g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ rab 'bar me dpung 'phro ba'i gzi 'od can/ / srung byed bka' yi 'khor lo'i=/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ / gcig bsdus 'jam dpal 'khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ / rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun 'dus dam tshig can/ / chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang dar ba dang*/ / bar chad bgegs kyi mtshan ma kun zhi nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol zhing*/ / 'gro don phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // 'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar pa'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan shambha lar/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog/ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud 'debs dang bkra shis zhes bya ba bzhugs/
